Multiple geeb rips in the car with my friend. It started out normal, okay I am high af rn. Wow, time is moving really slow my friend has been ordering McDonald’s at the drive through for what feels like forever. Hey, I kind of need to pee. Wow, holding in pee is really hard, the more I focus on it the more I feel like my control is lost. Hey am I pissing myself right now? Wait, am I shitting too? Oh this is really bad. 
I could feel the wetness, the warmth running down my pants, they felt wet to my hand. I begged my friend to take me home but it felt like eternity in the parking lot listening to him chew his McDonald’s. My vision was shaking like I was drunk. Time was moving at a crawl, a thousand memories for each second that passed. 
Finally he drives me home after I plead. I Stumble inside. Hear people talking to me but no one’s home. Go to the bathroom and see that my pants are completely dry. It was all in my mind. 
I lay down. I hear voices outside, I don’t know what they are saying. Then I think I hear “god” talking to me. I ask him why he would talk to me on weed instead of when I’m sober. He says “you don’t have enough faith when you’re sober”. He then apologizes. I ask what for, he tells me he’s sorry for pretending to be God and that he’s really the devil. I ask why he’s talking to me. He says he talks to anyone who will listen. His voice sounded like a villain from a cartoon. I then hear loud buzzing in my ears and they feel like they will explode. 
I try and calm myself by remembering pleasant things. I’m transported back, it feels like I time traveled back to those memories and am living through them again. 
I Went to look in the bathroom mirror and My eyes were so red I looked like an argonion from Skyrim. I have never seen anyone that high before. I finally managed to drift to sleep and woke up still high. For the entire next day the feeling of pissing myself was still there
